englisch.auto.label: Auto review
englisch.auto.description: Run without a sandbox after an experimental same-model review of every native tool call and PTC inner call.
englisch.auto.confirm.title: Enable Auto review (experimental)?
englisch.auto.confirm.description: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it; you approve or reject each call it denies. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.
